fact_text: The founder said the group once employed about 850 people, and that headcount has since come down as operating efficiency improved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The group runs five company outlets in Karachi (including Clifton, Dolmen Mall, Malir Cantt and Highway) and three in Lahore, with franchises in other cities.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The group has franchised outlets in Dubai, Malaysia, Qatar, Muscat, Jeddah, Riyadh and Dhaka, and planted a Pakistani presence in Singapore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The group opened in Nigeria and Kenya but closed both because of security problems, the founder said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder said the main overseas focus is the United States, which he described as a large market where a restaurant could open in each of its 50 states.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The group said it vets franchisees carefully before granting a franchise, and it keeps its menu halal with no alcohol, even when overseas partners asked to serve it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: Besides its restaurants, the group runs corporate catering, which it said includes work for Shell and other oil companies, while restaurant customers remain its main focus.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: In the early days the founder began sourcing around 4 am, buying produce at the vegetable market and meat at Empress Market, and drove the goods to the restaurant himself.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The restaurant launched with a menu of about 64 items, including steaks, several kinds of kebab and Afghani tikka, the founder recalled.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder said the restaurant kept an open kitchen so customers could see the food being prepared, which he said was meant to build trust.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder argued that time pressure is pushing families from home cooking to eating out or takeaway, since home cooking can cost more once food waste is counted.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder said Pakistan offers few entertainment options outside eating out, and poorly kept parks and grounds leave restaurants with much of the leisure demand.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder said restaurant output depends on inputs: quality raw meat, produce and spices give a better dish, and restaurant recipes are widely known anyway.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder said a restaurant must keep enough staff so food reaches customers hot and on time, since slow or cold service is what drives diners away.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)

fact_text: The founder advised young entrepreneurs to work three to five years in an established company before opening their own restaurant, to learn the business on someone else's cost.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'How Bar.B.Q. Tonight Took Pakistani Flavors Global | Scaled | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-18)
